title: Honey Roasted Carrots
description: Carrots roasted until tender and caramelized, glazed with honey, butter and thyme and finished with a squeeze of lemon.

image.alt: Whole roasted carrots glazed with honey and thyme

ingredients.prep: peeled and halved lengthwise if thick

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 425F oven}. Toss the carrots with the oil and salt on the baking sheet and spread them out.
Roast until tender and browned in spots, {time 20-25 min}, turning once.
Mix the honey and melted butter, drizzle it over the carrots, add the thyme and toss. Roast until glazed and sticky, {time 5 min}.
Squeeze the lemon juice over and serve.

notes: Use maple syrup instead of honey and oil instead of butter for a vegan version.
